About me

I'm a data analyst based in Alexandria, Egypt. During my training at the National Telecommunication Institute (NTI) I worked through the full analysis workflow: importing and cleaning data, querying databases in SQL Server, modelling data and presenting insights in interactive dashboards — both on my own and in teams.
